actions: Wait for new Pod readiness before judging fault effect.
Record the exact rollout and readiness timestamps.
analysis: A drill fault is effective only after rollout and new-Pod readiness; an old Pod still serving can hide the injected condition.
cautions: Do not mark a drill effective solely because a patch was submitted.

env：`DEMO_ERROR_RATE=1`，并确保 latency/startup 为正常值。rollout 完成、
